description: Shared ValidationError fixtures for the Character Sheet validators (specs/character-sheet/spec.md, Validation). The backend must produce exactly the expected items for every case; the frontend must do the same for every case with scope 'shared'. Item order is not significant. Unless a case says otherwise, the Investigator is a 1920s Antiquarian with every skill choice made and every occupation (EDU x 4) and personal interest (INT x 2) point spent.
